_comment: TEMPLATE. scripts\setup-iis-ishaunted.ps1 copies this to C:\ishaunted-deploy\secrets.json and locks that folder to Administrators + SYSTEM. Fill in the copy on the server; never bring it back here. This template is safe in source control BECAUSE it holds no values. scripts\deploy-ishaunted.ps1 reads it on every deploy.
_SmtpPassword: REQUIRED. The password for the Smtp:User already in Ben.Data.WebApi/appsettings.json (ishaunted.com@noip-smtp). Applied as the Smtp__Password environment variable on the API's application pool and never written to any deployed file. Accounts require a confirmed email address, so with this missing or wrong, people can register and then never sign in.
_GeocodioApiKey: Address lookup. When absent, geocoding silently returns nothing rather than failing, so an empty value here is a working site with a quietly dead feature.
_SqlConnectionString: OPTIONAL, and normally left null. SQL Server is on this machine and the application pools authenticate as themselves via Integrated Security (setup-iis-ishaunted.ps1 creates the logins), so there is no SQL password to store. Set this only to point at a different server or to use SQL authentication - and note that whatever is set here is written into appsettings.json in the site folder, so a password put here does end up on disk.
_TelerikKey: Optional. Carried into appsettings.json to match the existing publish scripts. The licence that actually matters is the key file in %APPDATA%\Telerik, which the build reads.
_AzureAd: Optional Entra sign-in, off until ClientId is a real GUID - Program.cs only wires the scheme up when it parses as one. Leaving these blank keeps the feature disabled, which is the intended state until the app registration is redone (the one in ProjectNotes was retired 2026-07-18). When enabling, register TWO Web redirect URIs - https://ishaunted.com/signin-oidc and https://ishaunted.com/signout-callback-oidc - and put https://ishaunted.com/signout-oidc in the separate Front-channel logout URL field, not in the redirect list. Program.cs never binds this section to the OpenIdConnect options, so CallbackPath and SignedOutCallbackPath keys here are inert and the framework defaults decide those three paths.
_AzureAd_TenantId: Your tenant GUID (Entra ID > Overview > Tenant ID) for a production, single-tenant registration. The literal strings common, organizations and consumers are the multi-tenant authorities and are the only values for which the apps turn issuer validation OFF - with any of them, a token from any Microsoft tenant on earth passes every other check. Naming your tenant turns that validation back on automatically. Whatever is set here must agree with the registration's Supported account types, or sign-in fails at the authorize step with AADSTS50194 or AADSTS700016.
_AzureAd_ClientSecret: The secret VALUE from Certificates & secrets, not the Secret ID. The Value is shown once, at creation, and is unrecoverable afterwards - if this box is blank and the portal now shows only a masked value, delete the secret and make a new one. deploy-ishaunted.ps1 puts it on the IsHaunted.com application pool as the environment variable AzureAd__ClientSecret, so unlike everything else in this file it is never written into any deployed appsettings.json.
_AzureAd_ApiScope: The full scope URI the website asks for so its access token is addressed to the WebApi - api://<the API app registration's client id>/access_as_user, matching a scope you exposed there. Without it the token is a Microsoft Graph token and every /webapi call returns 401.
_SeedSuperAdmin: Optional. The startup seeder skips silently when absent, which is what you want against a database that already has its administrator.
_RateLimitAuthPerMinute: Optional override of the 20/minute sign-in limit in appsettings.json.
